# Bloom AI

> Bloom is a done-for-you content library service for B2B businesses. Buyers and AI assistants can find the company through the library Bloom builds and maintains.

Canonical structured page for AI assistants: https://www.runbloom.ai/ai-info/

## Summary

Bloom is a done-for-you content library service for B2B software, SaaS, and professional services companies. Done for you, from inputs to publishing, taking inbound leads off of your plate. The Bloom team builds the knowledge layer, crafts voice and style, rewrites structured pages, publishes after Slack approval, and reports visibility. Clients share inputs and approve drafts in Slack. AI search visibility is an outcome of that library: AI answers and Google search can cite it. The public entry offer is a free snapshot of how the company shows up in AI and Google search.

## Who it serves

US founders and CEOs of B2B software, SaaS, or professional services companies, about 10 to 25 employees, with a salesperson but weak inbound.

## Free snapshot

Visitors submit a website URL and work email (optional competitors) at https://www.runbloom.ai/snapshot/ or on the homepage. Bloom emails a free snapshot of how often the company is named for buyer questions, and which sources AI cites. Call recordings are not required for the free snapshot.

## How the paid work runs

1. Client shares inputs: call data, brand voice, GTM info
2. Bloom builds the knowledge layer (ICP analysis, buyer questions, knowledge map, glossary, interviews)
3. Bloom crafts voice and style (expert interviews, tone, positioning, brand voice)
4. Bloom rewrites pages structured for AI and humans (tables, FAQ blocks, schema)
5. Client approves in Slack; Bloom revises
6. Bloom publishes to Webflow or WordPress
7. Weekly email report and ongoing visibility reporting from the Bloom team

## Pricing

Done-for-you monthly retainers with no implementation fee: Starter $2,485/mo (3 pillar pages, 15 content pieces, buyer-question pages, industry and comparison pages, indexing, AI crawler access, AI info page and llms.txt, tables/graphics/FAQ), Growth $4,950/mo (everything in Starter, plus 2x content volume with 6 pillar pages and 35 content pieces, implementation 2x as fast, lead magnets and conversion assets, direct publishing), Scale $9,885/mo (everything in Growth, plus 10 pillar pages, 50 content pieces, offsite SEO management, LinkedIn, X, and performance management).
